english.title: Permit use of motor cycle - no passenger foot rests

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a two wheeled motor cycle, namely **(..SPECIFY MOTOR CYCLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when suitable supports or rests were not available for the feet of a person being carried in addition to the driver
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 102 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
